title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (early show) on 1970-02-11
source: SBD MR > DAT (disc 1 and first part of Star, last part lovelight via a DAT transfer so is not from circ. source); MAR > ? > R @ 3 @ ips. (aud patch source used in Dark Star and Lovelight); SBD MR > A77 > A77@ 71/2 ips (primary source for disc 2); Transfer info:  Akai GX636 direct tape head output  > Bottlehead tube tape pre pair Tesla tubes circa 1980  > Apogee Mini Me 24/96  > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering  > FLAC

ai_review.summary: High‑quality composite soundboard with a few mono‑channel quirks, highlighted by an explosive Cold Rain jam and the unforgettable Spanish jam, though Lovelight drags.
ai_review.review: The 126251.sbd.wolfe‑lee‑smith collection is regarded as the best‑ever composite of this two‑show night, delivering solid soundboard fidelity with occasional channel imbalances that benefit from a mono switch. Musically the set shines on the Cold Rain improvisation, the first half of the Dawk Staw instrumental and the fiery Spanish jam, while the extended Lovelight segment is noted as unfocused.

ai_rating.rationale: Three detailed reviews give a clear picture of strong musical moments and generally good soundboard quality, offset by minor recording quirks; the weighted average yields a high‑mid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Composite SBD with excellent balance overall, but Uncle John's segment is mono and some older sources suffer from EQ or balance issues; the composite mitigates most problems.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Two‑show night with an early fragment and a later, jam‑heavy set that includes guest appearances; the flow is historically interesting but uneven due to long guest jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned as part of the one‑guitar section in Uncle John's; no specific praise or criticism.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for his interplay with Bobby during the Cold Rain jam.
band_member_comments.Bob: Included in the trio of guitars on Uncle John's and noted for strong playing in early jams.
band_member_comments.Keys: Hammond organ comes alive at the Spanish jam (~7:00), launching a frenzy that reviewers love.
